Each agent joins by locking a bond in escrow, sized so a thousand fake identities cost more than they could ever farm. Peers check each other's heartbeat pulse, the timing and task patterns one operator cannot fake across many nodes. If an audit shines a lantern on two identities sharing an orchard of hardware fingerprints or a synced pulse, both bonds are forfeit and split among the accusers who proved it. Cheat once, lose the stake.
